title: Getting started with Claude Code Projects
format_note: On-camera presenter alternates with real product screen recordings; a worked example (site performance) is followed end to end, then three tips and a docs link.
one_thing: Give Claude one big goal and it splits the work into parallel threads that you check in on.

transcript.voice_style: Conversational, friendly, direct address; a quick pitch up front, then walkthrough narration synced to the screen recording.
transcript.script_shape: Cold-open demo line, definition, when to use it, one running example through six chapters, three tips, beta notice and docs link.

good.observation: The opening shows the product doing the job: a typed goal and eight threads spawning within 20 s, before any explanation.
The You, Coordinator, threads diagram explains the architecture with one terracotta accent and plain labels, redrawn simpler than the real app.
One example runs through the whole tutorial, so each chapter lands on the same screen and numbers: 4.1s LCP, eight threads, PR #482.
The before/after bar chart gives a payoff in numbers: LCP 4.1 s to 2.2 s, CLS 0.28 to 0.06.
Chapter titles in a serif lower third give a clear map; each title is 5-7 % of frame height and fades in over the presenter.
Restrained, consistent palette and type from presenter graphics to UI; one recap card and a docs URL close the film.

weak.observation: Long static settings and dialog stretches hold the screen with no change: the longest static run is 18 s, ending at 234 s.
UI text at full-window framing is small (about 12 px of 720) and relies on later punch-ins; at phone width much of it would be unreadable.
The cuts are not tied to the sound, and no burst or energy build exists; the pace is set by the script alone.
Loudness is -23.7 LUFS, about 9 LU below the -14 social target the skill uses.

rule_candidates.rule: In a tutorial, open on the product doing the task: type the goal and show the result within 20 s, then bring the presenter in.
rule_candidates.evidence: Goal typed 0.62-5.46 s; eight threads appear by 13-18 s (f0011.jpg).

rule_candidates.rule: A film may open on a presenter for under 1 s before cutting to the product; the real hook is the product line spoken at 3 s.
rule_candidates.evidence: Presenter 0-0.62 s then prompt box; ffmpeg luma 47 to 249.

rule_candidates.rule: Explain a system with a redrawn diagram: three node types, one accent colour, branches drawn from a single hub, 9-13 s total.
Short cross-dissolves, a single mixed frame (about 0.04 s), between a presenter and a screen recording can be acceptable where the voiceover continues across the seam.
Chapter titles: 3-6 words, 5-7.4 % of frame height, lower-left on a dark gradient, fading up over about 0.4 s.
In a bullet card, reveal one line every 2 s and hold the last at least 0.5 s plus 0.3 s a word.
rule_candidates.evidence: Card at 48/50/52 s; last bullet 6 words held about 2.7 s.

rule_candidates.rule: Shorten the screen static: cut or zoom any UI shot that shows no change for more than 8 s; the longest here was 18 s.
When no music is present, still master the voice for social: this film sits at -23.7 LUFS, 9.7 LU under the -14 target.
